description: Extinct creatures in the untamed wilds: a new small world (region9 'EXTINCT WILDS', seed 1310133, SMALL REGION, 50 years, REAL_WORLD_EXTINCT = UNTAMED_WILDS, user 13 Oct) and a 4x4 fort with 50 dwarves (startdwarf 50, user 13 Oct; X6xw's 7 withered: a giant mosquito of the spring flying cast choked three citizens and the fort was lost at tick 84,470) on a savage temperate savanna (13,32 off 6,6; savagery 95, a brook). DF stocked 43 extinct species on its region tiles. Spring through summer, v7.5 with the 13 Oct rules: do the extinct casts arrive?

receipts.lua: local c = reqscript('seasonal-wildlife').loadConfig(); for _, r in ipairs(c.fp_created or {}) do local d = -1; if r.kind == 'cave' then d = df.global.world.world_data.underground_regions[r.cave].layer_depth end; print(('fp_created %s %s %d'):format(r.kind, r.token, d)) end; print('fp_created total ' .. #(c.fp_created or {}))
